publication_policy: Noether is already at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Do not loose-upload this micro-package. Fold it into a deliberate compact Noether current-control/source-audit rebalance that fronts reader PDFs and current TeX first.

packages.scope: German cumulative current-control package after Web R268 and the latest LocalCodex fix-bearing carry-forward work.
packages.base: Web R268 cumulative plus latest LocalCodex P06/P08/P09 source-certain carry-forward package.
packages.reader_surface: Contains cum_de_R269.tex and cum_de_R269.pdf; PDF_CHECKS_R269.json reports a 471-page cumulative PDF.
packages.source_witness: Includes source witnesses/renders for Paper 06 source pp.164, 166, 167, 174, 178, 185; Paper 08 source p.98; and Paper 09 source pp.112, 124, plus no-fix/source-trap ledgers.
packages.result: Promotes ten source-certain German replacements across Papers 06, 08, and 09 on top of Web R268. It also carries unchanged-span guards for P13, P15, P16, P17, P19, P21, P22, P30, P35, P36, P43, and the post-P43 tail.
packages.not_promoted: P09 p111 extra 'ist' row remains a no-fix trap with available witnesses. Latest local P11 page-audit package was no-patch and is not promoted into TeX in this pass.
packages.caveat: Current-control/source-certain patch layer only. This is not whole-Noether closure, not paper-by-paper certification, not multilingual synchronization, not critical-edition material, and not a reason to claim the Noether corpus is fully source-faithful.

It should be folded into the next Noether rebalance, not loose-uploaded above reader/current-TeX surfaces.
